seen.body:
## Behaviour
`qew close ITEM --reason not_planned|duplicate|superseded` today records only the enum. The reference forces the caller to choose and to name the other item: duplicate needs `--of ITEM`, superseded needs `--by ITEM` (stored on the `closed` event, validated to exist, not the item itself, one disposition only); free-text rationale goes in `--note TEXT`. Calling `close` with `--reason` carrying a free sentence is refused with a message listing the three values. Finished work is never closed as abandoned by default, and `qew close` refuses a `completed` reason with a message naming `qew complete` and `qew close --delivered-by` (see `close-delivered`). Closing a claimed item clears the owner (the fold does this today) and children are not closed implicitly.

## Scenarios
- duplicate and superseded: event stores the other item id, `qew show` of both ends mentions the link (prevents: an unexplained duplicate)
- no disposition, a free-text reason, `--completed`: exit 2 naming the right commands, zero events (prevents: finished work recorded as not planned)
- superseded by itself, unknown item, or two dispositions: exit 2, zero events (prevents: loops and contradictory records)
- close of a claimed item returns the owner to nobody and the item leaves `qew list --state claimed` (covered by fold)

## Reference coverage
5 reference test function(s): `test_close_walk_preserves_duplicate_and_abandoned_reasons`, `test_close_without_a_disposition_never_defaults_to_abandoned`, `test_close_completed_is_refused_and_names_the_replacement_commands`, `test_close_superseded_by_links_the_replacement_and_closes_as_completed`, `test_close_superseded_by_refuses_itself_and_every_other_disposition`

## Qew today
Reduced. The flow walk covers an invalid reason and a valid close/ready/reopen cycle. The enum has no linked item, no note, no self-reference refusal, and no guidance for `completed`.
seen.title: Require a disposition on `qew close` and record the linked item
